40:41.text: And O my people, how is it that I invite you to salvation while you invite me to the Fire?

40:42.text: You invite me to disbelieve in Allāh and associate with Him that of which I have no knowledge, and I invite you to the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.

40:43.text: Assuredly, that to which you invite me has no
supplication in this world or in the Hereafter; and indeed, our return is to Allāh, and indeed, the transgressors will be companions of the Fire.

40:44.text: And you will remember what I
say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Seeing of

40:45.text: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment -

40:46.text: The Fire; they are exposed to it morning and evening.
And the Day the Hour appears
, "Make the people of Pharaoh enter the severest punishment."

40:47.text: when they will argue within the Fire, and the weak will say to those who had been arrogant, "Indeed, we were
your followers, so will you relieve us of a share of the Fire?"

40:48.text: Those who had been arrogant will say, "Indeed, all
are in it. Indeed, Allāh has judged between the servants."

40:49.text: And those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell, "Supplicate your Lord to lighten for us a day from the punishment."
